mike_r: quick ask — can someone run a small micro-bench comparing streaming vs sync for function_call + structured-output paths? I saw ~2.1x overhead locally with tool payloads. need p95 + tokens/sec for canary decision. cc @sasha @vivian

sasha: when you say function_call do you mean the internal `function_call` serialization path or our external http tool proxy?

mike_r: internal function_call path (runtime->serializer->tool layer) while streaming enabled. tested with 512 token responses and warm KV cache. batch=1, concurrency 8.

vivian: i can run something on rtx-8000 pool today. what exact payloads/prompts should i use?

mike_r: replicate this prompt (short):
```
User: Please summarize the following logs and emit JSON schema: { ... }
Tool: returns ~4KB JSON blob
```
Also capture a run with structured-output disabled (plain text) and a `--no-prefetch` variant. Collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and time-to-first-chunk (stream-start delta).

priya: heads-up: our current profiler doesn't break out per-token serialization for structured outputs — i'll add a quick trace but results may be coarse. :thinking_face:

sasha: if viv posts logs i’ll diff vs non-streaming on the same VM image. i’ll also add a tiny script to toggle sync/stream endpoints and produce a one-line CSV.

infra-bot: Benchmark job queued: job/bench-1793004321 started on rtx-8000-pool (owner: vivian).

vivian: putting preliminary numbers here. streaming p50 85ms p95 240ms p99 410ms, sync p50 50ms p95 120ms p99 200ms. tokens/sec roughly 320 (stream) vs 620 (sync). tool payload serialization measured ~40ms extra when using structured-output. snippet: ```latency stats: p50 85 p95 240 p99 410```

mike_r: thanks — can you also capture a run with structured-output turned off (plain text) so we can isolate serialization cost?

vivian: will do, ETA ~45m.

sasha: :thumbsup: i’ll prepare the compare script that diffs the JSON blobs and produces a small table with ratios.

mike_r: if we see >1.5x overhead we should flip on a canary fallback to use sync function_call for tool-heavy routes (route-level). cc @priya

priya: agreed. i’ll prototype fallback wiring once we have the perf numbers so we can set a sensible threshold.

vivian: added plain-text run — results: streaming p95 180ms, sync p95 115ms, so structured-output adds ~60ms at p95 in this workload. saved logs in /mnt/bench/1793004321/*.log

mike_r: perfect. can you attach the CSV from sasha's script when ready? planning to cut a canary tomorrow morning based on these numbers.

sasha: will upload `stream_vs_sync_1793004321.csv` to the thread and drop a short summary.

priya: i'll start the fallback PR draft now, flagging the metric names to hook into: `route.tool_call.latency.p95` and `route.streaming.serialization.ms`.

mike_r: awesome — thanks all. this is exactly what we needed.
